name: Baatsun Pill
description: A thin dark pill near the bottom centre of the screen that shows baatsun's dictation state. It never changes colour — it opens: a 6px bar when idle, opening to hold white level bars while listening and a spinner while transcribing. Hover it and it opens into a start/stop button, so a long dictation can be ended with the mouse. Stays above every window, including fullscreen ones, and never takes keyboard focus.
